summary: Learn to diagnose workplace culture, align manager behaviours and build a practical improvement scorecard. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Creating a high-performance culture involves diagnosing workplace norms and turning shared values into observable behaviours. For HR business partners, people managers and department heads, this course supports practical assessment and improvement planning using the Competing Values Framework and Denison Model. Participants map culture signals, identify gaps between stated values and management practice, and develop team actions and a scorecard to review progress.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who influence workplace norms, management practice or culture improvement and need to translate broad values into observable actions.
prerequisites: Working experience in people management, HR, organizational development or change initiatives. No coding or programming is required.
